source.name: A non-modal offcanvas panel that allows page scrolling must not trap keyboard focus
source.scope: Real upstream bug (https://github.com/twbs/bootstrap/pull/33677) at 0bbe45cd977ae69f11b4cdd55e5d5be08e4a137a. Blind to the maintainers' fix 079f2cd90c247225eb71dff4d514faf50f653416; routing auto.

journey.title: Keep editing the report with the help panel open
journey.goal: Tab can reach the amount field while the non-modal panel is open

functionalJourney.title: Open and close the policy help panel
functionalJourney.goal: The panel opens and its close button hides it

guards.title: Close the help panel from the keyboard
guards.goal: The panel's close button is reachable and closes it

plan.root_cause: The offcanvas plugin unconditionally enforces a focus trap via _enforceFocusOnElement, preventing tab navigation out of the help panel when backdrop is false (non‑modal). This blocks reaching the amount field within the allowed tab transitions.
plan.repair_strategy: Make focus enforcement conditional on the backdrop setting: only apply _enforceFocusOnElement when this._config.backdrop is true, preserving modal behavior for backed drop instances while allowing focus to leave non‑modal offcanvas panels.
plan.expected_accessibility_effect: Users can tab from the help panel to the amount field and beyond, meeting the focus order requirement (WCAG 2.4.3) and ensuring keyboard operability (WCAG 2.1.1) for non‑modal panels.
functional_risks: If an offcanvas instance relies on the focus trap despite having backdrop=false, modal‑like behavior could be lost. The conditional uses the resolved _config.backdrop value, which reflects the data‑bs-backdrop attribute, so risk is limited to misconfigured instances.
verification_requirements: Verify that with data-bs-backdrop="false" the focus can leave the offcanvas and reach #amount within ≤6 tabs.
Verify that with data-bs-backdrop="true" (or default) the focus remains trapped inside the offcanvas when tabbing.
Ensure opening, closing, and backdrop click interactions continue to work as expected for both settings.
